record.title: Select the next transport or returned-state hypothesis from observed divergence
record.intent: Branch deliberately using the recovered grammar and completed observation.
requirements: Evaluate whether missing-device failure propagation matched prediction or a different transport branch was reached.
Use recovered consumers to choose coherent modeled state or further static recovery; do not return to per-store rediscovery.
Keep version interface identities distinct and treat UART FPGA timing and DDR behavior as hypotheses rather than inferred hardware truth.
acceptance: Admit and commit plus push a bounded successor before execution or record a concrete blocker.
